reviews.name: Roshan Ara Khanam
reviews.comment: I have attended an online MERN course from Full Stack Academy. It was a great learning experience with Mr. Mujib Sir, an industry expert. The explanation and method of teaching were excellent. I have learned new skills and techniques in programming.

reviews.name: Burhan Ashraf
reviews.comment: One of the best academies for everyone who wants to learn and develop their skills in the IT world. The atmosphere here is amazing, and the encouragement you get from the staff and everyone is incredible. I secured an IT job by learning here at Full Stack Academy.

reviews.name: Jaseem Ansari
reviews.comment: Full Stack Academy is doing its best in training students in the latest technologies. It is one of the best institutes. You must enroll here to build a career in the IT world. The faculty is well-qualified, and the atmosphere for learning is excellent.

reviews.name: Imtiaz Shaik
reviews.comment: I have been following Full Stack Academy since Day 1, and they have been doing great, especially in filling the gap between IT industry expectations, requirements, and the skills of freshers. They have helped many freshers secure placements in top IT companies.

reviews.name: Areeba Atif
reviews.comment: Full Stack Academy is the best place to learn about almost everything—from soft skills like personality development to technical skills like coding. The environment and the staff here encourage and motivate us to learn more.

reviews.name: Mirza Faizan Baig
reviews.comment: A very good opportunity for students living abroad to learn new things easily. Every student must upgrade themselves in these high-demanding sectors.

reviews.name: ADNAN
reviews.comment: Top quality learning and very good ambience.

reviews.name: Muhammad Iqbal
reviews.comment: Highlighted how the academy helps learners from both IT and non-IT backgrounds grow their careers in the technology field.

reviews.name: Mohammed Owais
reviews.comment: Shared that the AWS DevOps journey strengthened hands-on technical skills, confidence, communication, assessments and mock-interview readiness.

reviews.name: Md Abdullah
reviews.comment: Praised the training in current technologies, qualified faculty, learning atmosphere and domain-focused placement support.
